jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you are in daily contact with candidates and customers.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

Our client is an important player in the maritime industry and are internationally active. They are located in Zwijndrecht.

Jobomschrijving

As a Temporary Executive Assistant (80%) you will be the righthand of the head of department. 

You have an important role within the company: - Complex diary and travel management- Preparing for meetings (including PowerPoint presentations), taking minutes and drafting reports- Working closely with internal and external stakeholders- Organising events- Managing the mailbox and acting as the first point of contact by telephone- Keeping the database up to date- Onboarding new colleagues

- You have experience in a similar role- You are available to start this project immediately (from late September until the end of April 2027)- You communicate fluently in English and are able to have conversations in Dutch- You work in a structured manner, are organised and are a hands-on person- You are discreet and meticulous- You enjoy communicating with various internal and external stakeholders

The client is a global leader in the sustainable construction industry, focused on delivering innovative building solutions while prioritising environmental and social impact. They foster a collaborative, people-centric culture that emphasizes employee well-being, diversity, and continuous growth in an international setting.

Jobomschrijving

As a Product Manager your responsibilities are:

• Gather and translate customer and market insights into product ideas and improvements
• Oversee the full product lifecycle, from initial concept through launch to discontinuation
• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and expand the global product portfolio
• Track product performance and support forecasting with data-driven analysis
• Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., sales, R&D, marketing) to deliver on strategic goals
• Contribute to long-term planning and initiatives aimed at driving growth in international markets

A successful Product Manager should have:

• Proven experience managing products in an international B2B environment, ideally within the construction sector
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies
• Solid business acumen, including building and managing financial cases and performance metrics
• Technically savvy, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach to innovation
• Effective project manager, capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting
• Excellent communicator who collaborates easily across teams and with external stakeholders
• Adaptable, hands-on, and comfortable working in a dynamic, evolving environment
• Willing and able to travel frequently across regions
• Fluent in English, with strong interpersonal skills to operate in a global context

Our client is a global leader in connecting, fixing, lifting, and anchoring technology for the construction industry. Part of a major international group, they operate across 60 locations worldwide and contribute to some of the most sustainable and cutting-edge building projects globally, including the Paris Metro Rail project, the Burj Khalifa, and the Kennedy Space Centre. 

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and implement the CI program in consultation with site managers.
• Ensure follow-up and successful delivery of projects from start to finish.
• Lead multiple projects, both large and small, from design to execution.
• Craft custom solutions and provide expert insights to exceed client expectations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, management, and contractors to ensure project success.
• Develop, layout, and optimize industrial processes.
• Collect and analyze data to design, test, and implement new or improved processes.
• Support CI projects and Kaizen initiatives on-site.
• Implement best practices from other sites and help transition to Industry 4.0.
• Contribute to automation projects and build stability and productivity on critical machines.
• Supervise operational and CI projects from start to finish with the site team.
• Deliver training related to Kaizen, VSM, and CI methodologies.

• Engineering degree.
• Proven experience in process improvement, Lean tools, and project management.
• ERP systems knowledge.
• Familiarity with drawing packages and programming tools for robotics.
• Dutch, French, and English.
• Strong analytical skills, technical insight, and ability to work under deadlines.

Our client is a recognized provider of data, analytics, and insights for the automotive industry. With a strong international footprint, the organization supports key market players, including leasing companies, insurers, manufacturers, and importers, in making informed, data-driven decisions.

In Belgium, the company operates through a small, agile team while being fully integrated into a larger international network of experts and analysts.

Jobomschrijving

As Business Analyst BeNeLux, your main responsibilities will be to :

• Produce and maintain residual value forecasts for new and used vehicles across BeNeLux region
• Analyze large datasets using statistical methods and proprietary algorithms to generate accurate market predictions
• Continuously monitor automotive market trends, pricing developments, and competitor activity
• Apply strong market knowledge to complement and refine data-driven models
• Contribute to improving valuation methodologies and analytical tools
• Collaborate with a network of market analysts across Europe to ensure consistency and best practices
• Support commercial teams with insights for client interactions when needed
• Participate occasionally in industry events and client meetings across the region

• Strong analytical mindset with experience working with data (preferably in automotive, leasing, insurance, or related industries)
• Solid understanding of the automotive market, including vehicle pricing and trends
• Experience in data analysis, statistical modelling, or similar analytical work
• Comfortable working with large datasets and improving analytical models
• Autonomous, self-driven, and able to work effectively in a fully remote environment
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in international, virtual teams
• Fluent in French, Dutch, English

Our client is a global leader in food manufacturing, known for its strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.

The Process Expert plays a key role in optimizing production processes, leading new product introductions, and improving plant performance across liquid and solid chocolate processing operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead new product introduction (NPI), process transfers, and factory trials
• Optimize production lines to improve throughput, reduce waste and losses
• Define and implement process standards, work instructions and recipes
• Collaborate with R&D, quality, engineering and operations teams
• Analyze process performance and identify continuous improvement actions
• Support and coach shopfloor teams on best practices and standards
• Manage process validation linked to chocolate liquid & solid processing
• Drive product industrialization and ensure compliance with quality standards

• Engineering degree (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or similar)
• First experience in FMCG / food / process industry
• Strong knowledge of chocolate or similar processing technologies: Mixing, refining, conching, tempering, depositing
• Understanding of rheology and process parameters
• Familiarity with SAP, MES or industrial automation tools
• Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to influence, train and engage operational teams
• Fluent in English (and French/Dutch preferred)

jobs.occupation: AI & Automation Lead - Private Equity (MBB Background)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a high-potential profile from a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB: McKinsey, BCG, Bain) with 3-7 years of experience, to join a private equity platform undergoing a strong digital transformation.

This strategic role is focused on designing and driving AI and automation initiatives across both the investment structure and its portfolio companies.

Jobomschrijving

• 

Define AI & Automation Strategy
• Develop the overall AI vision and roadmap for the fund and its portfolio companies
• Identify high-impact use cases (productivity gains, revenue growth, cost optimization)
• 

Drive Execution
• Lead the implementation of AI and automation solutions across portfolio companies
• Ensure effective rollout from strategy design to execution (PoCs, scaling)
• 

Engage with Senior Leadership
• Work closely with investment teams and portfolio company leadership (C-level)
• Challenge and support management teams in adopting new technologies
• 

Value Creation
• Identify and unlock value creation opportunities through AI and automation
• Track performance and impact of implemented initiatives

• Experience: 3-7 years in a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB strongly preferred)
• Expertise: Strong exposure to AI, data, or automation-related projects
• Skills:
• Strong analytical and strategic thinking
• Hands-on, execution-driven mindset
• Ability to interact with senior stakeholders
• Languages: Fluent in English + French or Dutch required

Our client is an international and people-oriented company based in Brussels. They are known for their strong company culture, internal mobility, and commitment to developing talent. To support their growing HR department, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior HR Assistant ready to discover the world of Human Resources.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior HR Assistant, you will support the HR team across a variety of tasks, giving you a broad introduction to the field. Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting with the recruitment process: job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews
• Supporting the onboarding of new employees
• Handling HR administration: contracts, personnel files, absences, certificates
• Preparing HR documents and ensuring updated employee data
• Helping with payroll preparation by collecting and verifying information
• Participating in HR projects such as employer branding, training coordination, or wellbeing initiatives
• Being a point of contact for employees, providing clear and friendly support

• You graduated in HR, Psychology, Office Management, Business, or a related field
• Eager to start your career and develop strong HR skills
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
• Organized, communicative, and service-minded
• Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable handling confidential information
• A real team player who enjoys working with people

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability
